title: Fixing a Model That Learned Worse Cancer Means Lower Risk: Monotonic Constraints in Bladder Cancer Recurrence Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.00858v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Background and Objective: Clinicians expect recurrence risk to climb with cancer severity. In a UK multicentre trial, an unconstrained XGBoost model learnt that higher tumour stage and carcinoma in situ predicted lower recurrence risk, and discrimination, calibration, and SHAP were all blind to it. We developed a counterfactual testing framework to detect this inversion and a monotonic-constraint framework to remove it without hurting performance. Methods: BOXIT enrolled 472 patients with protocol-mandated cystoscopy across 51 UK sites (2007-2012); 435 had at least two years' follow-up (153 recurrences, 35.2%). We developed a counterfactual direction test and a monotonic-constraint correction, with constraint directions drawn from the EORTC and EAU risk systems, and evaluated both against unconstrained XGBoost and logistic regression on 18 predictors (seven directed) over 50 cross-validation folds. translated_title: 修正一个学出“癌症越严重风险越低”的模型：单调性约束在膀胱癌复发预测中的应用
translated_abstract: 背景与目的：临床医生期望复发风险随癌症严重程度的升高而增加。在一项英国多中心试验中，一个未加约束的XGBoost模型学习到更高的肿瘤分期和原位癌反而预示着更低的复发风险，而判别力、校准度和SHAP分析均未能发现这一错误。我们开发了反事实检验框架来检测这种方向颠倒，以及单调性约束框架来在不损害性能的前提下消除该问题。方法：BOXIT试验于2007-2012年在英国51个中心入组472名患者，方案要求进行膀胱镜检查；其中435名患者至少有两年的随访（153例复发，占35.2%）。我们开发了反事实方向检验和单调性约束修正方法，其约束方向来源于EORTC和EAU风险系统，并在50次交叉验证折中，将两者与未约束的XGBoost和逻辑回归在18个预测变量（其中7个施加了方向约束）上进行比较评估。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该研究针对膀胱癌复发预测模型出现的“肿瘤越严重、复发风险反而越低”的方向颠倒错误，提出反事实检验方法来检测该问题，并利用源自EORTC和EAU临床风险体系的单调性约束加以修正，且不损害模型性能。
en_tdlr: This study develops a counterfactual testing framework to detect direction inversions in bladder cancer recurrence prediction (where more severe cancer predicted lower risk) and a monotonic-constraint correction guided by the EORTC and EAU clinical risk systems, fixing the error without compromising model performance.
